exposure: BMI categories: normal BMI, obesity, and morbid obesity
cohort: 771 patients who underwent cesarean section between 2015 and 2016 at a single center
finding: Increasing BMI was associated with comorbidities such as hypertension and diabetes mellitus, and with increased intraoperative blood loss during cesarean section.
mod_finding: Increasing BMI was associated with increased intraoperative blood loss during cesarean section, but no differences in other obstetric, anesthetic, or neonatal outcomes were observed.
